name: Findem
tagline: AI talent intelligence for sourcing, hiring, and planning.
description: Findem is an AI talent-intelligence platform that builds enriched candidate profiles — its '3D data' attributes — from across the web to power sourcing, talent marketing, and analytics. Its agentic layer adds screening, scheduling, and job-post agents. Aimed at talent-acquisition teams hiring and planning beyond what a résumé shows.
insight: Raised a $30M Series B in 2022, bringing total funding to about $37M, with Wing Venture Capital among its backers.
edge: Goes beyond résumés with '3D' attribute data — inferred skills and career context — to surface candidates keyword search misses.
pros: Enriched profiles built from across the web
Sourcing, marketing, and analytics in one
Strong on diversity and talent insights

references.title: Findem Raises $30M in Series B Funding
